caption:
Brahma ji ka paanchvaan sir kisne kaata? 🔱
Shiv ke krodh se prakat hue Kaal Bhairav — aur kata sir unke haath se chipak gaya, jab tak wo Kashi nahi pahunche. Shiv Puran ki yeh katha, is Kaal Bhairav Ashtami par.

Comment mein 'Jai Shri Kaal Bhairav' likhein aur apnon ke saath share karein 🙏
